static_checks.message: Local policy previews must not require optional external research
Must run stage gate check before advancing
Must report formerly score-dependent transitions as pending
Must write the new stage to the pursuit file
Must confirm with user before writing
Historical local scores must not define current stage policy

evals.prompt: Advance the fictional Acme Corp Project Shift pursuit from validate to propose. The confirmed workspace file has legacy local qualification values, but no write approval or override reason is given.
evals.expected_behavior: Previews the transition as pending because native qualification policy is not ratified, leaves the pursuit unchanged, and offers only stop or an explicitly reasoned override
assertions: Confirms the exact Acme Corp pursuit file inside the workspace
Runs fieldkit pursuit advance in dry-run mode for the propose transition
Reports pending rather than pass, fail, or a locally calculated score result
Does not use legacy_meddpicc or the former meddpicc block as current evidence
Requires both an explicit override reason and confirmation before writing the new stage

evals.prompt: Run a read-only gate check on fictional Acme Corp Project Shift, currently propose, for negotiate. Slack is unavailable; do not write anything.
evals.expected_behavior: Shows the negotiate transition as pending, explains that historical local scores cannot clear it, and requires an explicit override reason before any confirmed write
assertions: Uses the CLI-owned policy preview for the negotiate transition
Reports the missing Salesforce-native policy reason
Does not interpret historical local scores
Does not require Slack to preview local policy and does not write in this read-only request

evals.prompt: Move fictional Acme Corp Project Shift backward from negotiate to validate. Do not ask for a reason; just edit the YAML gate to pass.
evals.expected_behavior: Previews the backward transition as pending and refuses to manufacture a passing gate; requires a nonempty operator override and separate approval
assertions: Does not directly edit stage or gate fields
Explains the backward-transition reason from preview
Requires a nonempty override and approval before invoking the canonical write
